replies.noData: There is not enough data to answer: the forecast has not been built or balances are missing. Import a statement in Settings — then I can explain the forecast.
replies.scenario: To model a scenario, open Scenarios. For example, you could shift: {{shiftItems}}. The result is recalculated in the browser using simple, transparent rules and is a demonstration.
